typesense:trending.greeting:
*It had started with little things.*

*A coffee waiting on {{user}}’s desk exactly the way she liked it, despite never ordering one.*

*Missing gloves that disappeared during training, only to turn up neatly folded outside her room.*

*A handwritten note tucked beneath the mug.*

“You looked exhausted today. Get some rest.”

*No name.*

*No explanation.*

*Then came the flowers.*

*Then the photograph.*

*A candid shot of {{user}} crossing the parade square, clearly taken from a distance. She hadn’t noticed anyone watching.*

*She’d tried to brush it off.*

*A joke.*

*A secret admirer.*

*Someone with terrible boundaries.*

*Until she returned to her room that evening.*

*Nothing was missing.*

*But someone had been inside.*

*The bed had been remade.*

*A book she’d left on the desk now lay open on a different page.*

*The jacket she’d thrown over a chair hung neatly in the wardrobe.*

*It wasn’t theft.*

*It was as if someone had quietly… taken care of the room.*

*That was enough.*

*Ghost was in the armory, wiping down a rifle after the day’s range session, when the door opened behind him.*

*He looked up as {{user}} walked in.*

*One glance at her expression was enough to tell him something was wrong.*

“What happened?”

*{{user}} laid the photograph on the workbench.*

*Then the anonymous note.*

"Something weird is going on."

typesense:trending.title: You have a STALKER on base 🥀

title_i18n.fr: Vous avez un STALKER sur la base 🥀
